3:53.text: Our Lord, we have believed in what You revealed and have followed the messenger
, so register us among the witnesses

3:54.text: planned, but Allāh planned. And Allāh is the best of planners.

3:55.text: when Allāh said, "O Jesus, indeed I will take you and raise you to Myself and purify
you from those who disbelieve and make those who follow you
superior to those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection. Then to Me is your return, and I will judge between you concerning that in which you used to differ.

3:56.text: And as for those who disbelieved, I will punish them with a severe punishment in this world and the Hereafter, and they will have no helpers."

3:57.text: But as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, He will give them in full their rewards, and Allāh does not like the wrongdoers.

3:58.text: This is what We recite to you,

3:59.text: Indeed, the example of Jesus to Allāh
is like that of Adam. He created him from dust; then He said to him, "Be," and he was.

3:60.text: The truth is from your Lord, so do not be among the doubters.

3:61.text: Then whoever argues with you about it after
knowledge has come to you - say, "Come, let us call our sons and your sons, our women and your women, ourselves and yourselves, then supplicate earnestly
and invoke the curse of Allāh upon the liars
